title: Progress Report
description: The AI student progress report: CEFR estimate, skill matrix, strengths and growth areas, learning styles, next steps, narrative and evidence counts. Replaces the bulk PDF/ZIP export (BulkReportExport.tsx + reportPdf.ts) and the browser-print copy (AIReportDialog.tsx); content from ReportDocument.tsx.

full.description: Generous layout: two-column skill matrix, strengths and growth areas side by side, the narrative in its own panel. Original order throughout.

compact.description: Tighter layout aimed at fewer pages: three-column skill matrix, learning styles beside next steps. Same text, same order.
